what: one combine of 64 separate pegs that do not touch: 36 s on truck, growing 4-9x per doubling; must finish in seconds
method: 64 non-touching 48-gon pegs of circumradius 2, 1 mm tall, 6 mm apart: each area 0.5*48*2^2*sin(2pi/48) = 12.5305, V = 64 * 12.5305 * 1. The join keeps them in one body (several lumps). A hang is a failure: time should grow with the number of bodies. valid is false only because the one body holds 64 separate shells, which the rig's one-shell check does not allow
